wholePhysicalScope: Native surveyed-mapping polygons for the named theatre building, fifteen associated structural features and the exact original public-domain Qualla front image.
lodDetails: Four authored levels retain the curved auditorium, arched portico, and stepped stage roofs.
limitations: Only the building exterior is modeled. Statuary and ornamental profiles will be simplified at catalog scale.
Mapped building parts and roof envelope are combined with an exact original front photograph. Rear openings and profiles without measurements are approximate.
